revenue.source: COST 10-K filings via financial_statements: FY2024/FY2025 acc. 0000909832-25-000101, FY2026 acc. 0000909832-26-000093 (Revenues / RevenueFromContractWithCustomer), USD millions

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 growth was 10.1% (303,154/275,235) and FY2025 8.2%; fade from 8% toward ~5.5% as scale grows, driven by comparable sales plus new warehouse openings.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2026 margin 3.85% (11,685/303,154), up from 3.65% FY2024 and 3.77% FY2025; hold ~3.9% given Costco's low-margin pricing model.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2026 effective rate ~24.7% (1 - net income 9,226 / pretax 12,251, acc. 0000909832-26-000093); rounded to 25%.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2026 capex 6,435/303,154 = 2.12%, FY2025 2.00%; held ~2.1% reflecting continued warehouse expansion.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y par, 2026-11-06) + relevered beta ~0.85 (Damodaran Retail Grocery & Food unlevered cash-corrected 0.848; Costco debt 6.2B vs very large market cap so D/E ~0) x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = ~8.65% cost of equity; debt weight negligible so WACC ~8.6%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal growth below the 4.86% risk-free rate and nominal GDP; 3.0% reflects continuing share gains/inflation.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 6,162 (LTD noncurrent 3,914 + current 2,248) - cash 20,207 - short-term investments 1,094; acc. 0000909832-26-000093; USD millions

diluted_shares.source: Weighted average diluted shares 444,427,000, us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOutstanding, acc. 0000909832-26-000093; expressed in millions
